## BoundReferenceOf type

The bound reference a client produces from reference data `Data`<!-- -->: the variant of `Data`<!-- -->'s form and cardinality, to `Data`<!-- -->'s resource, with the record and identifier types of that resource in `Resources`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type BoundReferenceOf<
  Resources extends ResourceTable,
  Data extends ReferenceData,
> = Data extends IdentityReferenceData
  ? IdentityReference<
      ResourceRecordOf<Resources, Data['resource']>,
      ResourceIdOf<Resources, Data['resource']>,
      Data['resource']
    >
  : Data extends SelectorReferenceData
    ? SelectorReference<ResourceRecordOf<Resources, Data['resource']>, Data['resource']>
    : Data extends IdentityCollectionReferenceData
      ? IdentityCollectionReference<
          ResourceRecordOf<Resources, Data['resource']>,
          ResourceIdOf<Resources, Data['resource']>,
          Data['resource']
        >
      : Data extends SelectorCollectionReferenceData
        ? SelectorCollectionReference<
            ResourceRecordOf<Resources, Data['resource']>,
            Data['resource']
          >
        : never
```

**References:** [ResourceTable](./contracts.resourcetable.md)<!-- -->, [ReferenceData](./contracts.referencedata.md)<!-- -->, [IdentityReferenceData](./contracts.identityreferencedata.md)<!-- -->, [IdentityReference](./contracts.identityreference.md)<!-- -->, [ResourceRecordOf](./contracts.resourcerecordof.md)<!-- -->, [ResourceIdOf](./contracts.resourceidof.md)<!-- -->, [SelectorReferenceData](./contracts.selectorreferencedata.md)<!-- -->, [SelectorReference](./contracts.selectorreference.md)<!-- -->, [IdentityCollectionReferenceData](./contracts.identitycollectionreferencedata.md)<!-- -->, [IdentityCollectionReference](./contracts.identitycollectionreference.md)<!-- -->, [SelectorCollectionReferenceData](./contracts.selectorcollectionreferencedata.md)<!-- -->, [SelectorCollectionReference](./contracts.selectorcollectionreference.md)

## Remarks

Its `resolve()` yields `Promise<Record>` for a single object and `Promise<readonly Record[]>` for a collection. A union of data gives the union of the bound variants.
